ticket.subject: Heads-up
ticket.body_text:
Hello,

Just a heads-up whenever you get a chance: all of our API calls have returned 500 for the last 40 minutes, across every workspace we have. No rush from our side, our nightly jobs can wait a bit.

Best,
Chloe

label_notes: tone_mismatch: calm, but every API call failing across all workspaces is an outage = P1; the impact is ongoing now, so urgency high despite 'no rush'.
